opponent_formation_family.desc: Structural family of the OPPONENT's recorded formation in each cohort fixture.

opponent_profile.desc: Band of the opponent's measured pre-fixture profile on a named axis. Bands are computed deterministically from history strictly before each cohort fixture's kickoff.

own_formation_family.desc: Structural family of the subject's RECORDED formation in each cohort fixture. Historical fixture context; needs no announcement timestamp.

period.desc: Full match, or a half split where the metric supports one.

referee.desc: Restrict to fixtures with the same referee. FootyStats-only.

venue.desc: Whether the subject played at home or away in the cohort fixtures.
